chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ibn Faddal, from Dawud ibn Farqad, from Bashir al-Nabbal, who said:

I went out with Abu Abdillah عليه السلام until we came to Masjid al-Shajarah. Then Abu Abdillah عليه السلام said to me: O Nabbal. I said: At your service. He said: It is not obligatory upon anyone from the people of this camp to pray four rak'ahs except me and you, because the time of the prayer entered before we set out.

key_terms.لَبَّيْكَ: an expression meaning: I am at your service
key_terms.مَسْجِدَ الشَّجَرَةِ: Masjid al-Shajarah, the location mentioned in the report
key_terms.وَقْتُ الصَّلَاةِ: the prescribed time of the prayer
key_terms.يُصَلِّيَ أَرْبَعًا: to perform the prayer as four rak'ahs in full

ai.seo_question: If the time of prayer begins before a person starts traveling, should the prayer be offered in full or shortened?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses the ruling of prayer for one whose prayer time begins before departure. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that he and Bashir al-Nabbal must pray the full four-rak'ah prayer because the prayer time had entered before they left, unlike the others in the traveling party.
